quest.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Blazing Poetry
quest.description: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." Paimon plans to take him to see Luhua Pool today...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a super special view, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: So much water, super special colors, mm!

choices.text: You two sound like you could be siblings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But it is very special, isn't it? How would you describe it, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Like Cryo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's that even supposed to mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But this place really is special. {NICKNAME}, do you still remember that artist from before?

choices.text: Vermeer, you mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! That's him! Didn't we help him place those glowing pearls into two giant statues?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He even gave us a painting afterward!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is this what you're looking for?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It should be... here! Come have a look, Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm! Very alike! Is it photo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, someone drew this.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Eh? But... if people have photo, why drawing?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh. Actually, why is that, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: I suppose people have a desire to make something that is uniquely theirs.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, that sounds reasonable.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Something that you draw yourself has much more sentimental value.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true, drawing something out brushstroke by brushstroke is pretty hard!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm... Then is taking photos of me easy, not-hard, and not-sentimental?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh!? N—No, that's not it, we just...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Drawing takes a long time, you know. It's pretty tiring.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! If we spend too long drawing, your legs might fall asleep on you from all that standing still.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: When I was sealed in stone, always standing.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: So when freed from seal, a long time later, legs very sore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ergh, that sounds very painful...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: But Paimon can flip-flap. Legs won't be sore.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey now! Floating's a full-body exercise. It's super tiring!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Ooh, fire flower!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, are you listening, or what?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: A Flaming Flower, you mean?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true, Chinju Forest doesn't have any Flaming Flowers at all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do you want one, Kichiboushi?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yes! Looks very warming.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Then you'd better ask {NICKNAME} nicely!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, wants! Thank you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Do all bake-danuki talk like this...

choices.text: Kameras are pretty expensive, you know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh!? Are they? Then don't we risk breaking ours by bringing it into battle, to climb mountains, swim, and such?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... So, be more careful next time, okay?

choices.text: Sorry, who now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Vermeer! Don't you remember the time we helped him place those glowing pearls into two giant statues?

choices.text: Like Anemo?
Ah, the two of you possess such splendid vocabularies.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm, splendid, like Paimon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uh, Paimon doesn't think that's what {NICKNAME} means... But whatever! That's a clever boy, Kichiboushi!

choices.text: A super special view!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh, aren't you using a couple of words too few, {NICKNAME}?

talks.objective: Give 1 Flaming Flower Stamen to Kichiboushi

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, want fire flower. Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: So warm.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: If we had a Flaming Flower at Dragonspine, would be good!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's got a point. We should probably have gone better prepared...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Paimon, if we had a very big flower, could we make the snowy mountain have no snow?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: P—Probably not...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We could take Kichiboushi to see a "very big Flaming Flower."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Wait, you mean...

choices.text: I mean the Pyro Regisvine, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then, guess that's Kichiboushi's training for today!

choices.text: Let's get going.

talks.objective: Go into the depths of the cavern where the Pyro Regisvine is

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: So big! So hot! Amazing to have big fire flower!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right? Ooh, also...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hang on a moment, Kichiboushi. Let's take a photo of you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In this steaming hot place?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the whole point!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm... Okay...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Ooh.. So hot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, guess you know now, eh, Kichiboushi?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Know what, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can you imagine if we had to draw you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And that's why we chose to take photos instead! It's not that we don't care. It's precisely because we care about you that we decided to save time!

choices.text: Oh, so that's what you were intending to do.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Understood. Photo, good. So... hot...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's take the heat source out. The quicker, the better.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mmmm...

choices.text: Ridiculous...
You're not wrong, but it's still way too hot in here...

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, so strong!

choices.text: I'm so-so.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon fight often?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come to think of it, the goal of our journey is to help you find your lost relative, but we always wind up in fights along the way.

choices.text: It's fine. I quite like fights.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... That's nice and all, but there's better hobbies out there for sure, right?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: #When I become great bake-danuki, will become as strong as {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can do it for sure! But you've got to promise Paimon...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yes, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... Ahem! Even if you become a powerful bake-danuki like Ioroi, promise that you won't bully those weaker than you, or pick fights whenever you want!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don't be like that big, fiery, flower that started spewing flames the moment it saw {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Then when is fighting okay?

choices.text: When it's self-defense...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm... Not really understanding, but I promise Paimon. No bullying weak people, no picking fights.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's a good boy, Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Next up... Huh, this should be the final stop out of the eight that Ioroi set down...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm...

choices.text: When you need to protect others...
When you need to stand up for what's right...
Battles are bothersome, honestly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true, but sometimes we've just got no choice, eh?

choices.text: We've fought this sort of thing enough times by now.
